projects.name: Fun World Studio (video maker)
projects.chat: Claude project "Fun World Statistics" (video factory chats); data research in its own topic chat
start: Double-click “Fun World Studio.command” in ~/Movies/FunWorldStats
or in Terminal: cd ~/Movies/FunWorldStats && ./start_studio.sh
Close the Terminal window to stop it
needs: Once: ./setup_mac.sh (makes the .venv with Python, Pillow, ffmpeg)
upload/client_secret.json (Google OAuth, YouTube Data API v3) — first upload logs in once
Picture Reel on the server for “Free pictures” (optional)
AI Pictures set up on the Mac for “AI pictures” (optional, ~9 GB)
projects.notes: The studio makes the videos; Claude researches data and writes stories. Shorts max 90 s. One button publishes to YouTube + Facebook + Instagram; TikTok app is in production review.

projects.name: Picture Reel (free pictures → video)
projects.where: Ubuntu server, port 8642 (systemd service picture-reel); client on the Mac in ~/Movies/FunWorldStats/picture-reel
start: On the server: sudo systemctl start picture-reel
Check it: systemctl status picture-reel
Is it reachable from the Mac? cd ~/Movies/FunWorldStats/picture-reel && python3 reel_client.py --check
needs: Server running; Mac on the home network or Tailscale
projects.notes: Remove completely: delete the picture-reel folder on the Mac; on the server sudo systemctl disable --now picture-reel && rm -rf ~/picture-reel

projects.name: AI Pictures (local image generator)
start: Used automatically by the studio (🎨 AI pictures tab)
Terminal: cd ~/Movies/FunWorldStats/ai-pictures && .venv/bin/python ai_pictures.py "castle at sunrise"
needs: Once: ./setup_ai.sh (Stable Diffusion XL + Lightning, ~15 GB free disk)
Apple Silicon Mac, 16 GB RAM recommended
projects.notes: Free, no AI credits, works offline after setup. Delete the folder to remove it.

projects.name: Tennis app (predictions)
projects.where: Ubuntu server — Docker stack “tennis” in ~/tennis-app (PostgreSQL + web), port 8090
projects.chat: Claude project for the tennis app (moved off Lovable court-chronicle-60)
start: cd ~/tennis-app && docker compose up -d db web
update: cd ~/tennis-app && git pull && docker compose build loader model && docker compose up -d --build web
needs: Docker on the server
~/tennis-app/.env with POSTGRES_PASSWORD (and ODDS_API_KEY for odds)

projects.name: Football stats (corners, shots …)
start: sudo systemctl start football-web football-sync.timer
Health: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8095/football/health
update: Automatic from GitHub (autoupdate) and the GitHub “Football” workflow
By hand: cd ~/kasparsleitis.com && git pull && sudo cp football-app/*.py /opt/football/ && sudo cp -r football-app/static /opt/football/ && sudo systemctl restart football-web
needs: Telpu O replay app + Cloudflare Tunnel running (the public page reads data through it)
/opt/football/.env: API-Football Pro key, ADMIN_PASSWORD = the admin password

projects.name: Indoor O Replay (Telpu O / TELPO ceļi)
projects.where: Ubuntu server — Docker stack “telpuo” in ~/kasparsleitis.com/telpuo-app, port 8092 + Cloudflare Tunnel
start: cd ~/kasparsleitis.com/telpuo-app && docker compose --profile public up -d --build
update: Automatic: cron runs autoupdate.sh every 5 min when telpuo-app/ changes on GitHub
needs: .env: ADMIN_KEY (the admin password) and TUNNEL_TOKEN (Cloudflare)
kasparsleitis.com DNS on Cloudflare
projects.notes: This app also serves the data for /serverinfo, /football and this page.
